checks: Existing-card notes autosave once after a pause, preserve formatting and unrelated branches, show saved state, and leave the panel and tree in place.
Typing continues during an in-flight save; the newer generation is subsequently saved without being replaced by the older response.
Changing cards flushes to the original target; the next card uses its own notes and Ctrl+Enter saves without closing.
An unrelated agent edit merges with the human’s pending note without losing either change.
Failed saves remain visibly unsent and survive reload; a later same-node agent edit preserves the recovered draft and blocks overwriting until deliberately resolved.
Source reading uses the same dock; Back restores the exact note text, caret and scroll without moving the tree.
Opener-related live tabs retain separate focus reports; different visible selections are reported as ambiguous to the agent.
Standalone notes survive reload, remain isolated between two exported canvases, export correctly and never change the live session.
Two tabs of the same offline canvas save different cards concurrently and retain both notes.
Same-card offline races keep one accepted note and a recoverable conflicting draft; a clean tab’s pagehide cannot erase it.
A cyclic browser recovery record is ignored safely and the usable embedded canvas stays visible without a Saved claim.
Two separately started blank canvases retain their own questions when the earlier tab reloads.
Blocked browser storage never claims Saved; the human note remains visible and can still be exported.
Mobile notes autosave with the panel open and the action row within the viewport.
